name: Merra
title: Grocer
examine: Brisk as a morning market. The traveler's cape on her wall is older than her shop, and cleaner than anything in it.
lines: Fresh eggs, yesterday's bread at half, and no credit — except for Nib, who eats free and pretends she doesn't.
My brother Tilo can carve a rose out of oak but can't finish a chair. Family is like that: all the talent, sideways.
The cape on the wall belonged to my Edwin. The road kept him. I keep the cape. We've an understanding, the road and I.
